title: La Barrica del Valle, VISTA STORIES
comment: barrica-valle (VISTA): cava de barricas de una vinícola familiar en el Valle de Guadalupe, Baja California. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.LEOPOLDO_GARZA: Mexican winery owner from Baja California, 67 years old, tall and heavy-set, light skin, thick silver hair combed back, a full grey beard, a dark-brown suede jacket over a black shirt, a silver belt buckle, dark jeans, brown boots, his hands empty.
chars.CIRILO_BUSTOS: Mexican vineyard foreman, 56 years old, dark-brown sun-tanned skin, short black hair with grey at the temples, a black mustache, a faded denim work shirt, a beige wide-brim work hat, brown work trousers, worn boots, his hands empty.
chars.AMPARO_GARZA: Mexican woman from Baja California, 62 years old, light-brown skin, shoulder-length grey-blond hair, pearl stud earrings, a cream wool cardigan over a navy-blue blouse, grey trousers, flat shoes, her hands empty.
chars.ESTEBAN_SALINAS: Mexican man, 35 years old, fair skin, neat short light-brown hair, clean-shaven, a tan leather jacket over a black turtleneck, a slim gold watch, dark trousers, polished black shoes, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_CAVAVALLE: Wine cellar of a family winery in Valle de Guadalupe, Baja California, in the evening: stone walls, rows of oak wine barrels on wooden racks, a wet stone floor, warm hanging lamps, an arched wooden door open to vineyard rows at dusk, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
